text_block_list.text:
Betting it all on a hundred squid, aiming 
for the spirit of a big catch. A fateful 
tide bound by a promise made that day, a 
grand showdown amidst the raging waves. 
And now, let the race begin.

It's time for the Arima Kinen with Gold 
Ship! ...For some reason, Gold Ship was 
burning with competitive spirit against 
Eishin Flash as a fisherman.
